//: MemorySync automatic memory for the Devin CLI / Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf). Place as .devin/hooks.v1.json in a project, or ~/.config/devin/hooks.v1.json (%APPDATA%\devin\hooks.v1.json on Windows) for every project. Replace <PLUGIN_SCRIPTS> with the absolute path to the plugins/memorysync/scripts folder from github.com/memorysyncio/memorysync-plugins. Requires Node.js >= 18 and MEMORYSYNC_API_KEY in the environment. Every script exits 0 on every failure - memory being down can never break a Devin session.
